scope.label: Ops Map
scope.summary: Discovery and design for one team or your whole firm.
in: A report and the files to edit it

copy.hero_line: An Ops Map follows how work really flows through your firm, then gives you a clear plan.
copy.offer_meta: 3 weeks · one team or the whole firm
copy.price_note: Fixed fee, agreed before we start.

method_steps.title: Map the work
method_steps.text: Interviews, captured knowledge and process maps

method_steps.title: Match and design
method_steps.text: Ranked solutions and an agreed roadmap

method_steps.title: Walk through the report
method_steps.text: Editable files and clear next steps

method_beats.title: Listen to the team
method_beats.text: Interview the people doing the work. Agree what growth and better service mean to them.

method_beats.title: Capture their knowledge
method_beats.text: Bring useful knowledge out of people’s heads, including the difficult cases.

method_beats.title: Map the workflows
method_beats.text: Follow real examples across teams. Find where information helps the next person act.

method_beats.title: Draw the process maps
method_beats.text: Make handovers, delays and roles clear. Build on your current tools and planned work.

method_beats.title: Rank the opportunities
method_beats.text: Compare revenue, cost and time. Agree value, effort, readiness and risk with the team.

method_beats.title: Set out the roadmap
method_beats.text: Choose the next actions and owners. Walk through the report together.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Priya.
about.lead: I founded Northlight Ops after 15 years running operations in accountancy and care. Now I help service firms use AI to grow, cut costs and give people hours back.

facts.title: 15 years
facts.text: Running operations in accountancy and care.

facts.title: Maps first
facts.text: I learn how the work flows before anything is built.

promises.title: We start with your people.
promises.text: We talk to each group and learn how the work really gets done.

promises.title: We show what changes.
promises.text: For each task, the report says where AI could help, what stays with people, and how the work changes.

promises.title: You work well apart.
promises.text: London, home or another country: shared ways for your team to work with AI agents.

goal_cards: We follow the work as it really happens.
We pick the solutions that help the most.
We say who does what, and in what order.
report_defaults.ai_rule: AI never changes the books or emails a client on its own.
report_defaults.ranking_note: We agree the order with your team. Value, effort and risk guide each choice.
rules: A person makes every final choice.
AI shows its working, so it can be reviewed.
We start small, test, then grow.
AI does not change the books by itself.
AI does not email clients by itself.
roadmap: Interview the team. Draw the road from records to advice.
Score value, effort and risk. Agree the order.
Name who does what, and when. Decide if you build.
